title: Conversation response
description: The response to POST {endpoint} (201), and to POST {endpoint}/{id}/messages, /handoff, /handoff/cancel, and /close (202), without the wait query parameter. Spec sections 8.3, 8.9, and 8.12. A successful POST means the Company accepted the request, not that it acted on it, so the response has only conversation_id. With wait, a POST responds as a read of events would (events-response.schema.json), which also matches this schema.
